Hope you're doing well. As I mentioned earlier to you, I have decided to
leave my current job at our company and am looking for a new job. I would really
appreciate if can write a recommendation letter for me.
Best Regards,
Kyle Moore

emails.subject: Re: Job Search Help
emails.body: I am happy to! But give me a couple of days, I am a bit busy right now.

emails.subject: Re: Re: Job Search Help
emails.body: Sure, no problem. Thanks a lot!

emails.subject: Leaving Job
emails.body:
Hi Susan Burton,
Just wanted to let you know that I have decided to leave our company and am looking
for a job right now. I will stick around for a couple though until I find a new job.
I have had a great time working with you. I will miss working with you.
Best Regards,
Kyle Moore

emails.subject: Re: Leaving Job
emails.body: Oh, I am sorry to hear that. I will miss working with you too.
